title: Twist E22: Projected additive energy and relation-yield diagnostics
status_note: Proposed E22; not started. Projected sets must exist; diagnostic/collector separation and independent row checking are unimplemented. A separate runnable protocol and source/checker pins are required.
blocked_on: note:Projected sets must exist; diagnostic/collector separation and independent row checking are unimplemented.
question: Do coupled trace images have an additive structure that predicts more useful decompositions after cardinality and fiber multiplicity are controlled?
decision_value: A robust structural difference selects a specifically frozen family for further work. An energy increase without independent-row or cost improvement is not a collection win. A known-log diagnostic is never presented as an executable DLP shortcut.

resources.notes: Proposed pilot: one CPU, 4 GiB, at most 2^20 pair/group operations per base and 60 seconds per histogram cell; an incomplete histogram stays incomplete. Full resources remain unestimated. The nominal disk field is not an estimate; calibrate and freeze it before readiness.

outputs.result_schema: Not frozen; required evidence fields are in the linked design. No result exists.

env.name: unassigned-native-rust
env.recipe: Design only; implement native driver, independent checker, checkpoints and source/protocol pins before readiness.

funding.rationale: Blocked proposal with no run estimate, below the existing funded seed cards. Adding it changes no runnable-work priority or funding.

cairn.notes: No lab publication, lease, run, resource allocation or funding transaction has been performed. The failing sentinel is intentional.
